Location: Boston, MA (Hybrid, 3 days in office)

About Harborlight Analytics
Harborlight Analytics builds document intelligence tools for regional banks and credit unions.

What you'll do
- Build and maintain retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines that answer questions over policy documents
- Design prompt and context strategies, and evaluate LLM output quality with automated test sets
- Containerize services with Docker and deploy them to AWS (ECS or Lambda)
- Work with data engineers to keep document ingestion pipelines reliable
- Write clear documentation for internal users

Requirements
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field
- 1+ years of experience building machine learning or LLM applications
- Strong Python and SQL skills
- Hands-on experience with LLM frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph
- Experience with vector databases (e.g. Pinecone, FAISS, or pgvector)
- Familiarity with AWS services and containerization

Nice to have
- Experience fine-tuning transformer models with Hugging Face
- Exposure to LLM evaluation frameworks
- Experience with FastAPI
- AWS certification

Benefits
Health insurance, 401(k) match, and a learning budget.
